desc: Select approach: adaptive index sqrt decomposition with on-the-fly prefix columns and hybrid partial-partial handling (no stored N x M tables).

Implement input parsing, adaptive block size, query decomposition (fa,ra,fb,rb), and partial-partial answers grouped by block pair (direct for tiny cases, sorted two-pointer, row-by-row 2D prefix when estimated cheaper).
Implement on-the-fly A-side processing: maintain cumulative per-A-element costs over B full blocks, answer A-remainder vs B-full queries grouped by fb, and collect block-block costs C.
Build the 2D block prefix P from C and add full-full contributions to the answers.
Implement on-the-fly B-side processing symmetrically to add B-remainder vs A-full contributions, then output all answers.
Test samples and edge cases (N=1, S=1, block boundaries, max prefixes, large values) and optimize Python loops/local variables.
